items.source: Returns the list of loaded import candidates.
items.translation: 返回已加载的导入候选项列表。

items.source: Contains @Configuration import candidates, usually auto-configurations. The load(Class, ClassLoader) method can be used to discover the import candidates.
items.translation: 包含 @Configuration 导入候选项，通常是自动配置。 可以使用 load(Class, ClassLoader) 方法来发现这些导入候选项。

items.source: Loads the names of import candidates from the classpath. The names of the import candidates are stored in files named META-INF/spring/full-qualified-annotation-name.imports on the classpath. Every line contains the full qualified name of the candidate class. Comments are supported using the # character.
items.translation: 从类路径加载导入候选者的名称。导入候选者的名称存储在类路径上名为 META-INF/spring/full-qualified-annotation-name.imports 的文件中。每一行包含候选类的完全限定名称。支持使用 `#` 字符添加注释。

items.source: iterator in interface Iterable<String>
items.translation: iterator 在接口 Iterable<String> 中。
